summary: An 8.43 km hiking trail climbs to this East Kootenay lookout northeast of Canal Flats; the sources read give no build or staffing history.

access.note: Listed as a hiking trail. The listing says no high-clearance vehicle is needed for the drive, but the final 8 km is narrow and steep.

visit.trail_note: 8.43 km trail with a steep 1.5 km switchback section; the route uses one-way roads and needs careful navigation.

evidence.supports: lookout is in the East Kootenay area of BC
hike listed at 8.43 km; destination called an old fire lookout station
destination called an old fire lookout station
evidence.quote: This is a great trail to an old fire lookout station.

evidence.supports: trail climbs steeply through thick forest
evidence.quote: The next 1.5 km switchbacks up a steep slope through thick forest cover.

evidence.supports: crosses avalanche slopes to a ridge south of the lookout
evidence.quote: The trail crosses several avalanche slopes and eventually intersects the ridge south of the lookout.

evidence.supports: view north over the Kootenay River Valley
evidence.quote: To the north, the Kootenay River Valley stretches out to the horizon.

evidence.supports: no high-clearance vehicle needed; final 8 km narrow and steep

notes_for_editor: No build date, staffing, fire or fate source was found in the pages read, so the story covers the site and the trail only. Record location (firelookout.ca 50.30075, -115.62482) conflicts with the OpenStreetMap way (about 50.295417, -115.614243, per the brief); the OSM page text read has no coordinates, so this is not resolved. Access 'public' is inferred from a public hiking listing; no closure notice was found. The OSM tag 'disused:emergency' is not used as a status source.
